panels.title: Run timeline, 7 days (laser mA; dark and HK runs at 0)

targets.queryText: SELECT ts_epoch AS time, CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'General scan' THEN laser_ma END AS "General scan", CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Stability' THEN laser_ma END AS "Stability", CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Manual' THEN laser_ma END AS "Manual", CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Self trigger (dark)' THEN 0 END AS "Self trigger (dark)", CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'External trigger (LDs off)' THEN 0 END AS "External trigger (LDs off)", CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Other' THEN laser_ma END AS "Other", CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'HK Digitizer' THEN 0 END AS "HK Digitizer" FROM (SELECT ts_epoch, purpose, laser_ma FROM daq_run UNION ALL SELECT ts_epoch, 'HK Digitizer', NULL FROM hk_run) WHERE ts_epoch >= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 7 * 86400 ORDER BY ts_epoch

targets.queryText: SELECT scan_id AS "group", MIN(ts) AS start, MAX(ts) AS "end", CAST(MAX(CAST(wavelength AS INT)) AS TEXT) || ' nm' AS wl, COUNT(*) AS runs, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CAST(CAST(run AS INT) AS TEXT)) AS run_numbers, MAX(CAST(rot2 AS TEXT) || ' / ' || CAST(tilt2 AS TEXT)) AS "rot2 / tilt2", GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CAST(status AS TEXT)) AS status FROM daq_run WHERE scan_id IS NOT NULL AND scan_id != '' GROUP BY scan_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(rot2 AS TEXT) || '/' || CAST(tilt2 AS TEXT)) <= 1 ORDER BY MIN(ts_epoch) DESC LIMIT 50
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT scan_id AS "group", MIN(ts) AS start, MAX(ts) AS "end", CAST(MAX(CAST(wavelength AS INT)) AS TEXT) || ' nm' AS wl, COUNT(*) AS runs, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CAST(CAST(run AS INT) AS TEXT)) AS run_numbers, MAX(CAST(rot2 AS TEXT) || ' / ' || CAST(tilt2 AS TEXT)) AS "rot2 / tilt2", GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CAST(status AS TEXT)) AS status FROM daq_run WHERE scan_id IS NOT NULL AND scan_id != '' GROUP BY scan_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(rot2 AS TEXT) || '/' || CAST(tilt2 AS TEXT)) <= 1 ORDER BY MIN(ts_epoch) DESC LIMIT 50

targets.queryText:
SELECT time, MAX(CASE c WHEN 3 THEN 4 WHEN 2 THEN 3 WHEN 4 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END * 10 + c) % 10 AS state FROM (SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp, 'utc') AS INTEGER) / MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1)) * MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1) AS time, CASE
  WHEN Ch0_Stat IS NULL AND Ch1_Stat IS NULL AND Ch2_Stat IS NULL AND Ch3_Stat IS NULL THEN 4
  WHEN (Ch0_Stat = 4096 AND Ch1_Stat = 4096 AND Ch2_Stat = 4096 AND Ch3_Stat = 4096 AND COALESCE(Ch0_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch1_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch2_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch3_V, 0) = 0) THEN 2
  WHEN (COALESCE(CAST(Ch0_Stat AS INT), 0) | COALESCE(CAST(Ch1_Stat AS INT), 0) | COALESCE(CAST(Ch2_Stat AS INT), 0) | COALESCE(CAST(Ch3_Stat AS INT), 0)) & 7128 THEN 3
  WHEN (COALESCE(CAST(Ch0_Stat AS INT), 0) | COALESCE(CAST(Ch1_Stat AS INT), 0) | COALESCE(CAST(Ch2_Stat AS INT), 0)) & 1 THEN 0
  ELSE 1 END AS c FROM monitoring_data WHERE timestamp >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AND timestamp < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
